generate_single_header: run the script to merge multiple C/C++ headers into a single header file
compare_and_update: run compare_and_update to atomically replace an old file with a new one only if content differs
append_recursive_includes: run the append function to recursively expand include directives into an output file
generate_with_line_refs: run the script with --linerefs to output active line references to original source files
generate_with_git_hash: run the script with --hash to embed a git commit hash in the generated header file
